display_long_description:
The Most Explosive Sport in the World Comes to VR!

Step into the vibrant atmosphere of a traditional Colombian "tejería" from the comfort of your home. Tejo Strike is the ultimate virtual reality simulation of Colombia’s national sport. Combining physics-based precision, cultural authenticity, and the satisfying thrill of pyrotechnics, this game is built from the ground up to showcase the power of the Meta Quest 3S.

What is Tejo?
Imagine a game that combines the skill of horseshoes with the excitement of professional fireworks. In Tejo, players throw a heavy metal disc (the tejo) across a long court filled with a clay box (el barro). In the center lies a metal ring (el bocín) lined with small gunpowder envelopes called mechas. Your goal? Hit the mecha and make it go BOOM.

Key Features:

Realistic Physics-Based Throwing: Feel the weight of the tejo in your hand. Our custom physics engine replicates the arc and impact of a real throw, requiring genuine skill and practice to hit the target consistently.

Immersive Colombian Environments: Play in beautifully rendered environments that capture the soul of Colombia. From rustic countryside courts to lively urban tejerías, complete with traditional music and the cheers of the crowd.

Tactile Haptic Feedback: Every hit on the clay and every thunderous explosion is felt through your controllers, providing an immersive experience that tells you exactly how close you were to the mark.

Visual Spectacle: Powered by URP (Universal Rend
